speaker: DAUGHTER
text: He has mistook the brake I meant, is gone

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: After his fancy. ’Tis now well-nigh morning.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: No matter; would it were perpetual night,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: And darkness lord o’ th’ world. Hark, ’tis a wolf!

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: In me hath grief slain fear, and but for one thing,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: I care for nothing, and that’s Palamon.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: I reck not if the wolves would jaw me, soACT 3. SC. 2

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: He had this file. What if I hallowed for him?

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: I cannot hallow. If I whooped, what then?

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: If he not answered, I should call a wolf,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: And do him but that service. I have heard

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Strange howls this livelong night; why may ’t not be

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: They have made prey of him? He has no weapons;

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: He cannot run; the jingling of his gyves

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Might call fell things to listen, who have in them

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: A sense to know a man unarmed and can

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Smell where resistance is. I’ll set it down

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: He’s torn to pieces; they howled many together,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: And then they fed on him; so much for that.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Be bold to ring the bell. How stand I then?

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: All’s chared when he is gone. No, no, I lie.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: My father’s to be hanged for his escape;

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Myself to beg, if I prized life so much

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: As to deny my act, but that I would not,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Should I try death by dozens. I am moped;

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Food took I none these two days;

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Sipped some water. I have not closed mine eyes

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Save when my lids scoured off their brine. Alas,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Dissolve, my life! Let not my sense unsettle,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Lest I should drown, or stab, or hang myself.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: O state of nature, fail together in me,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Since thy best props are warped! So, which way now?

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: The best way is the next way to a grave;

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Each errant step beside is torment. Lo,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: The moon is down, the crickets chirp, the screech

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: owl

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Calls in the dawn. All offices are done

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Save what I fail in. But the point is this—

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: An end, and that is all.
